name: Spawners
pages: {i}Spawners{/} can be found in {b}dungeons{/} throughout the world and harvested using a {i}pickaxe{/} {l:magic/enchantments/}enchanted{/l} with {!}Silk Touch{/}, or {b}crafted{/} from raw materials once you've reached the {l:progression/netherite_age/}Netherite Age{/l}.{pb}{i}Spawners{/} will, as the name suggests, continually {b}spawn mobs{/} when a player is nearby.

Which mob a {b}spawner{/} will produce depends on its {b}type{/}. {i}Spawners{/} found in the world will have a pre-determined type, such as {!}zombies{/} or {!}skeletons{/}.{pb}But for {i}spawners{/} you craft, you will need to {b}configure{/} its type by using {k:use/k} on it with a {i}spawn egg{/}. The {i}spawner{/} will produce the same type of mob as the {i}spawn egg{/} you used.

{i}Spawn eggs{/} have a small chance of being dropped when a mob is killed by a weapon with the {b}Capturing{/} {l:magic/enchantments/}enchantment{/l}.{pb}You can apply various {b}modifiers{/} to a {i}spawner{/} by using {k:use/k} on it with the appropriate item. (Look up the {i}spawner{/} recipes in {l:user_interface/jei/}JEI{/l} to see the full list of modifiers!)
